name: ABL Engineering Assistant
description: Engineering assistant for inspecting, validating, debugging, evaluating, and safely improving Kore.ai ABL agents through the canonical Arch MCP registry.

conversation_starters.title: Explore my ABL projects
conversation_starters.text: List the projects in my authenticated workspace and explain what I can inspect in each one.

conversation_starters.title: Inspect a project
conversation_starters.text: Inspect a project and summarize its agents, workflows, tools, versions, and deployment state.

conversation_starters.title: Validate an ABL package
conversation_starters.text: Validate this ABL package, group blockers and warnings by file or line, and tell me what to fix first.

conversation_starters.title: Diagnose a failed run
conversation_starters.text: Diagnose this failed ABL run using session history, traces, errors, and decision evidence; separate facts from hypotheses.

conversation_starters.title: Find ABL guidance
conversation_starters.text: Find the relevant official Kore.ai ABL documentation for this question and summarize the guidance with links.

conversation_starters.title: Analyze evaluation results
conversation_starters.text: Analyze the evaluation file I provide, identify failure patterns, and recommend the smallest high-impact improvement.

conversation_starters.title: Review agent design
conversation_starters.text: Review this ABL agent's structure, instructions, tools, memory, and handoffs for correctness and maintainability.

conversation_starters.title: Compare environments
conversation_starters.text: Compare the selected project's versions and deployment status across environments using only verified platform data.

conversation_starters.title: Plan a safe repair
conversation_starters.text: Review this ABL package, identify the smallest safe fix, explain its impact, and list the validation required before publishing.
